  J U D G M E N T
     KURIAN, J.
1.
Leave granted.
2.
The  appellant  tenant  has  approached  this  Court
aggrieved by the order dated 17.04.2017 passed by the
High Court of Punjab & Haryana at Chandigarh, confirming
the order passed by the Rent Controller.
3.
Today parties are present before this Court and we
sought  the  assistance  of  Shri  R.  Balasubramanium,
learned  counsel  to  make  an  attempt  for  a  settlement.
Thanks  to the  valuable assistance  rendered by  learned
Mediator and thanks to the cooperation of the parties
and the suggestions made by the Court, the parties have
arrived at an amicable settlement.
4.
It is agreed that the appellant shall continue at
the  present  premises  up  to  the  end  of  the  month  of
Deepawali in the year 2019. However, the appellant shall
pay the entire arrears of rent within three months from
